sheet.title: SYNCHRONOUS MODEM BUFFER 1050
sheet.note: Parts, gates and wires read pin by pin from the scan on 2026-11-23. Switches, resistors and capacitors are not parts in this format; they are described in net notes. Pins of a 74153/74157 drawn as a stack of small boxes are read with the rule that a pin number sits above its wire. Register-level reading: docs/2A50-reading.md; catalogue map: docs/2A50-catalogue-map.md.
